thread:
Elaine (support): Customer reported 400 on /invoke -> toolcall. Error: JSON schema validation failed. They say it started after SDK bump.
Sam (infra): Can you paste the request body and exact error from our gateway logs?
Elaine (support): Pasting minimal repro from customer (redacted):
```
POST /v1/invoke
{
  "tool": "invoice-create",
  "args": {
    "amount": 199.99,
    "currency": "USD"
    // missing billingProfile.id on purpose (customer uses legacy SDK)
  },
  "auth": { "token": "redacted" }
}
```
Gateway error: `ValidationError: billingProfile.id is required; additionalProperties not allowed: "debug_mode"`

Tess (eng): Sounds like two issues: (1) required field now enforced: billingProfile.id, (2) our validator rejects extra top-level debug_mode key the SDK used. Which SDK version are they on?

Elaine (support): They said `redwood-js@0.9.2` (legacy shim). They attached gateway log excerpt: `schema: required [billingProfile.id]; received type number for orderId` (so maybe coercion issue too).

Kei (billing): If billingProfile is missing we can't route customer account. We added required in schema to avoid ambiguous routing, but we may be able to make it optional with a deprecation path. What's the impact?

Sam (infra): Repro on staging: I took their payload, added auth header and toggled `additionalProperties: true` in validator — it passes but we lose strictness. Quick workaround: gateway can coerce string->number for orderId and ignore unknown top keys when flag enabled.

Tess (eng): Long term we should: 1) Add a compatibility shim in our SDK to populate billingProfile.id if present in customer metadata, 2) Add a controlled validator-leniency feature behind a route flag so legacy tenants can opt-in. We shouldn't relax globally.

Elaine (support): Customer asking for immediate unblock — can we provide a short-term patch? They need invoices today.

Sam (infra): I can enable a per-tenant compatibility toggle in routing so their requests accept extra props and coerce types. Need tenant id and a quick auth from account team. @Kei can you confirm tenant id and approval?

Kei (billing): Tenant ID: T-8823. Approved for a 24h compatibility window to unblock billing ops. Please log the change and set an automatic rollback at +24h.

Tess (eng): I'll open a small PR to add a shim that will: if billingProfile missing and account metadata contains legacyBillingId, copy that into billingProfile.id; coerce numeric orderId -> string. Patch will be minor but needs canary. ETA 2 hours.

Sam (infra): Enabled tenant-level leniency for T-8823 (route flag `compat.schema_lenient=true`). Added audit entry: `infra/flag change by Sam at 1725560500`.

Elaine (support): Customer confirmed invoices are now created. They added: "Thanks, works. Please don't break again." :relieved:

Tess (eng): Follow-ups: 1) Backfill schema docs and deprecation notes for SDK, 2) Add better error code mapping so responses tell customers exactly what missing field to add and a link to migration guide, 3) Add telemetry to count leniency usage.

Kei (billing): I'll schedule a billing sync to ensure no invoices were duplicated during the window. Also, we should queue a contract note for enterprise customers using legacy SDKs.

Elaine (support): Closing the immediate support loop. Filing internal ticket: SW-12477 (compat shim + docs) and alerting product. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
